chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Switching bands with Red Allen
summary: He and Allen kept moving between Mills' Blue Rhythm Band, Lucky Millinder and Fletcher Henderson.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: But you said that you sent for him and then you and Henry Red stayed very close associates, right?
Yeah. He quit, I quit; I quit, he quit. He went with Mills' Blue Rhythm Band, he sent for me and I quit.

Mills' Blue Rhythm Band. When I was with Lucky's band we were in Philadelphia and I got a telegram from Fletcher Henderson, asking me to call him. I've got it in the scrapbook. He said, "I want to talk to you about Red Allen." That's when Red and I went with Fletcher. We'd switch around like that.
So this was during the 30's that you were switching around in the bands?

It's just like holding a conversation. You understand each other when you talk. I knew what Red was going to play anytime and he knew what I was going to play, so we understood each other by playing. But other than that, that was about it.
